component.name: Goley Revival Linux
component.summary: Native GTK4 + Libadwaita Linux launcher for Goley Revival
Goley Revival için doğal GTK4 + Libadwaita Linux başlatıcısı

description.p: An Anime Game Launcher ve Faugus Launcher tarzında tasarlanmış, Goley Revival'ı Linux üzerinde Windows başlatıcı penceresini açmadan ve 0x80090029 (ncrypt ECDSA_P256) hatasına takılmadan çalıştıran doğal GTK4 + Libadwaita başlatıcısı.

ul.li: Fix a mouse-wheel thunk jump encoding error that could crash the game while changing resolution or scrolling graphics settings.
Preserve mouse helper registers and validate all input patch locations before modifying game code.
Add crash diagnostics and compiled x86 regression tests; validate repeated resolution changes, confirmations, and wheel events under Wine/DXVK.
Fix fullscreen resolution lock on 1080p/1200p+ monitors by preserving selected D3D9 backbuffer resolution in borderless fullscreen mode with hardware upscaling and accurate mouse coordinate scaling.
Expose all standard 16:9, 16:10, and 4:3 resolutions in in-game graphics settings under Wayland/XWayland.
Add one-click self-update button ("Güncelle") to check for and install launcher updates directly from GitHub Releases.
Fix "GameLauncher: preparing the launch data failed" by embedding a self-contained 3DES-CBC engine and bcrypt.dll IAT hook in ncrypt.dll.
Clean up stale bcrypt.dll overrides and broken symlinks in Wine/Proton prefixes.
Detect game launch failures immediately instead of waiting for the 150s timeout, and fix expired session restore handling.
Report launcher exits and show the last expected stage on launch timeouts.
Refresh live logs and include Wine/Proton output in copied support reports.
Record application, desktop and session information for troubleshooting.
